title: Weather
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child identifies the weather at different times of the day, reads weather symbols and predicts the weather from signs.

floor.question: What is the weather when the sun shines brightly?

representations: a class weather chart for one week
pictures of white and dark clouds
steps: Look outside and name the weather.
Record it at three times of day.
contexts: a misty morning in the highlands
a hot afternoon at games time

board.do: Draw a sky with dark clouds and bending trees.
Wait for the child to say rain and wind.
Draw the rain and wind symbols.

misconceptions.ask: It is sunny in the morning. Will it be sunny all day?
misconceptions.repair: Record the weather at 8, 12 and 3 o'clock for a week. Compare.

misconceptions.ask: There are a few white clouds. Will it rain?
misconceptions.repair: Show pictures of light white clouds and dark rain clouds. Sort them.

misconceptions.ask: What does this symbol mean: curved lines blowing sideways?
misconceptions.repair: Blow on a paper strip and draw what you see. Compare with the rain symbol of drops falling down.

misconceptions.ask: When is it usually hottest: morning or afternoon?
misconceptions.repair: Feel the ground or a wall in the morning and after lunch.

checks.question: Dark clouds are gathering. What will the weather be?
